top_signals.title: Yen’s changing fortunes might finally be spooking the bears
top_signals.summary: New tailwinds from capital repatriation, unwinding carry trades and U.S. political pressure are now giving short speculators cause to rethink their long-term game.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Lutnick to Review Pentagon Deals Involving Cerberus Companies
top_signals.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has been chosen by the Department of Defense to review any transactions between the Pentagon and companies associated with Cerberus Capital Management, according to a US official.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
